repos.description: 🙃   A delightful community-driven (with 2,400+ contributors) framework for managing your zsh configuration. Includes 300+ optional plugins (rails, git, macOS, hub, docker, homebrew, node, php, python, etc), 140+ themes to spice up your morning, and an auto-update tool that makes it easy to keep up with the latest updates from the community.
repos.summary_zh: Oh My Zsh 是一个社区驱动的 zsh 配置管理框架，提供 300+ 插件（如 Git、Docker、Node.js）和 140+ 主题，支持自动更新。它通过丰富的扩展功能提升终端体验，让用户在开发效率与个性化之间获得平衡，同时保持轻量与易用性。
repos.summary_en: Oh My Zsh is a community-driven framework for managing zsh configurations, offering 300+ optional plugins (e.g., Git, Docker, Node.js) and 140+ themes, with auto-update support. It enhances terminal productivity and personalization through extensible plugins and beautiful themes, balancing power and simplicity for developers.

repos.description: mall项目是一套电商系统，包括前台商城系统及后台管理系统，基于Spring Boot+MyBatis实现，采用Docker容器化部署。 前台商城系统包含首页门户、商品推荐、商品搜索、商品展示、购物车、订单流程、会员中心、客户服务、帮助中心等模块。 后台管理系统包含商品管理、订单管理、会员管理、促销管理、运营管理、内容管理、统计报表、财务管理、权限管理、设置等模块。
repos.summary_zh: mall 是一个完整的电商系统，包含基于 Spring Boot + MyBatis 的前台商城和后台管理系统，支持 Docker 容器化部署。前台涵盖商品展示、搜索、购物车、订单流程等核心电商功能；后台提供商品、订单、会员、促销等全链路管理。集成 Elasticsearch、Redis、RabbitMQ 等主流中间件，适合企业级电商项目开发与学习。
repos.summary_en: Mall is a full-featured e-commerce system with front-end portal and back-end management, built on Spring Boot + MyBatis and deployed via Docker. It includes product display, search, cart, checkout, and user management on the frontend, and supports comprehensive backend operations like inventory, orders, promotions, and analytics. Integrated with Elasticsearch, Redis, RabbitMQ, and other modern technologies, it serves as a robust platform for enterprise-level e-commerce development and learning.

repos.description: Memos is an open-source, self-hosted note-taking app that brings your everyday thoughts together in a personal timeline. Your data stays yours, and you choose what to keep private or share.
repos.summary_zh: Memos 是一款开源、自托管的快速笔记工具，专为即时记录设计。原生支持 Markdown，轻量高效，完全由用户掌控数据。提供简洁的时间线界面，无需分类导航，单命令部署，支持 SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL，具备完整的 REST/gRPC API，适合个人知识管理和团队协作。
repos.summary_en: Memos is an open-source, self-hosted note-taking tool designed for instant capture. Native Markdown support, lightweight (~20MB Docker image), and full data ownership with zero telemetry. Features timeline-first UI, single binary deployment, and extensible via REST/gRPC APIs for personal knowledge management and team use.

repos.description: ⭐AI-driven public opinion & trend monitor with multi-platform aggregation, RSS, and smart alerts.🎯 告别信息过载，你的 AI 舆情监控助手与热点筛选工具！聚合多平台热点 +  RSS 订阅，支持关键词精准筛选。AI 智能筛选新闻 + AI 翻译 +  AI 分析简报直推手机，也支持接入 MCP 架构，赋能 AI 自然语言对话分析、情感洞察与趋势预测等。支持 Docker ，数据本地/云端自持。集成微信/飞书/钉钉/Telegram/邮件/ntfy/bark/slack 等渠道智能推送。
repos.summary_zh: TrendRadar 是一款 AI 驱动的舆情监控工具，支持多平台热点聚合、RSS 订阅与智能关键词筛选，提供 AI 翻译与分析简报推送。集成微信/飞书/钉钉等 8+ 通知渠道，支持 Docker 部署与 MCP 架构，赋能 AI 对话分析、情感洞察与趋势预测，30 秒快速部署。
repos.summary_en: TrendRadar is an AI-powered public opinion and trend monitoring tool that aggregates multi-platform hot topics, RSS feeds, and offers smart keyword filtering. It delivers AI-translated analysis briefs via 8+ notification channels (WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, etc.), supports Docker deployment and MCP architecture for AI-driven sentiment analysis and trend forecasting, with a 30-second setup.

repos.description: LLM API 管理 & 分发系统，支持 OpenAI、Azure、Anthropic Claude、Google Gemini、DeepSeek、字节豆包、ChatGLM、文心一言、讯飞星火、通义千问、360 智脑、腾讯混元等主流模型，统一 API 适配，可用于 key 管理与二次分发。单可执行文件，提供 Docker 镜像，一键部署，开箱即用。LLM API management & key redistribution system, unifying multiple providers under a single API. Single binary, Docker-ready, with an English UI.
repos.summary_zh: One API 是一个统一的 LLM API 管理与分发系统，支持 OpenAI、Azure、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、文心一言等数十家主流大模型，通过标准 OpenAI API 格式统一接入，实现密钥管理、负载均衡与二次分发。提供单可执行文件部署、Docker 镜像及英文 Web UI，开箱即用，适用于企业级多模型集成场景。
repos.summary_en: One API is a unified LLM API management and distribution system that supports over 20 mainstream models including OpenAI, Azure, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, and Baidu's Wenxin. It standardizes access via OpenAI-compatible APIs, enabling key management, load balancing, and redistribution. Deployable as a single binary or Docker image with an English web interface, it offers out-of-the-box functionality for enterprise multi-model integration.

repos.description: JumpServer is an open-source Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform that provides DevOps and IT teams with on-demand and secure access to SSH, RDP, Kubernetes, Database and RemoteApp endpoints through a web browser.
repos.summary_zh: JumpServer 是一款开源的堡垒机（PAM）平台，为 DevOps 和 IT 团队提供通过浏览器安全访问 SSH、RDP、Kubernetes、数据库及远程应用端点的能力，支持权限管理、会话审计与自动化运维，具备完善的 RBAC 权限控制与多协议支持。
repos.summary_en: JumpServer is an open-source Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform enabling secure, on-demand access to SSH, RDP, Kubernetes, databases, and RemoteApp endpoints via a web browser, featuring comprehensive auditing, RBAC, and multi-protocol support for DevOps and IT teams.

repos.description: 基于 Playwright 和AI实现的闲鱼多任务实时/定时监控与智能分析系统，配备了功能完善的后台管理UI。帮助用户从闲鱼海量商品中，找到心仪产品。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Playwright 和 AI 的闲鱼多任务实时监控工具，支持自然语言创建任务、多模态商品分析、定时调度与智能筛选。提供完整 Web 管理界面，集成 ntfy.sh/Bark/Telegram 通知，支持 Docker 一键部署与账号代理轮换，帮助用户高效发现目标商品。
repos.summary_en: AI-powered Xianyu monitoring system using Playwright for real-time/periodic multi-task tracking and analysis. Features natural language task creation, multimodal product analysis, cron scheduling, advanced filters (region/price/new-post), and full web UI with notifications via ntfy.sh/Bark/Telegram. Supports Docker deployment, account rotation, and proxy management.

repos.description: Bytebot is a self-hosted AI desktop agent that automates computer tasks through natural language commands, operating within a containerized Linux desktop environment.
repos.summary_zh: Bytebot 是一个自托管的开源 AI 桌面代理，通过自然语言指令自动化计算机任务。它运行在容器化的 Linux 桌面环境中，拥有完整的虚拟桌面，可自主使用各类应用程序、处理文件、登录网站、读取文档并执行复杂的多步骤工作流程，真正实现 AI 拥有独立计算机的自主操作能力。
repos.summary_en: Bytebot is an open-source, self-hosted AI desktop agent that automates computer tasks via natural language commands. Operating within a containerized Linux desktop environment, it provides a full virtual desktop where it can use any application, manage files, authenticate on websites, process documents, and execute complex multi-step workflows with complete autonomy.

repos.description: 小红书（XiaoHongShu、RedNote）链接提取/作品采集工具：提取账号发布、收藏、点赞、专辑作品链接；提取搜索结果作品、用户链接；采集小红书作品信息；提取小红书作品下载地址；下载小红书作品文件
repos.summary_zh: XHS-Downloader 是一款功能强大的小红书（XiaoHongShu/RedNote）作品采集与下载工具，支持提取账号作品、收藏、点赞链接，采集作品信息及下载地址，批量下载图文、视频、LivePhoto 文件，具备断点续传、文件完整性校验、自定义命名格式、剪贴板监听、MCP 调用等高级功能，适用于内容创作者与数据收集场景。
repos.summary_en: XHS-Downloader is a powerful tool for extracting and downloading content from Xiaohongshu (XHS/RedNote). It supports fetching posts, likes, collections, and albums, downloading media files (images, videos, LivePhotos), with features like resume downloads, file integrity checks, custom naming, clipboard monitoring, and MCP integration, ideal for content creators and data collectors.

repos.description: 使用小爱音箱播放音乐，音乐使用 yt-dlp 下载。
repos.summary_zh: XiaoMusic 是一个基于 Python 的智能家居音乐播放工具，通过小爱音箱实现本地音乐播放，支持使用 yt-dlp 自动下载网络音频资源。提供 Web 管理界面，支持 Docker 部署，适用于 NAS 环境，具备完整的音乐库管理和设备控制功能。
repos.summary_en: XiaoMusic is a Python-based smart home music player that enables local playback via Xiaomi AI speakers, supporting automatic audio downloads using yt-dlp. It features a web management interface, Docker deployment, and is optimized for NAS environments with full music library control.

repos.description: 这个项目是一个基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Docker 镜像代理工具。它能够中转对 Docker 官方镜像仓库的请求，解决一些访问限制和加速访问的问题。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Docker 镜像代理工具，通过中转请求解决官方仓库访问限制与加速问题。支持 Docker、Containerd、Podman 等多种容器运行时配置镜像加速，提供一键部署方案，适用于跨境网络环境下的镜像拉取优化。
repos.summary_en: A Docker image proxy tool built on Cloudflare Workers that relays requests to official repositories to bypass access restrictions and accelerate downloads. Supports configuration for Docker, Containerd, and Podman runtimes with one-click deployment options, ideal for optimizing image pulls in cross-border networks.

repos.description: ChatGPT官网接口纯协议的逆向实现，支持GPT-Image-2模型、文本模型，兼容OpenAI接口协议，在线批量生图/编辑图，号池管理，支持可编辑PPT/PSD文件逆向，支持导入CPA、sub2api号池 、支持接入Cherry  Studio、New Api 等软件
repos.summary_zh: ChatGPT2API 是对 ChatGPT 官网能力逆向封装的 OpenAI 兼容 API 代理，支持文生图、图片编辑与多图组图功能，集成号池管理、多种账号导入方式及 Docker 自托管部署，提供完整的在线画图工作台与缓存机制。
repos.summary_en: ChatGPT2API is an OpenAI-compatible API proxy that reverse-engineers ChatGPT's image generation and editing capabilities, featuring account pool management, multi-import methods, Docker deployment, and a built-in online drawing workspace with caching support.

repos.description: Red Ink - A one-stop Xiaohongshu image-and-text generator based on the 🍌Nano Banana Pro🍌, "One Sentence, One Image: Generate Xiaohongshu Text and Images."
repos.summary_zh: 红墨是基于🍌Nano Banana Pro🍌的一站式小红书图文生成器，支持一句话生成完整图文内容，包含智能大纲、封面页和内容页批量生成。采用Python Flask后端与Vue 3前端，支持Docker一键部署，集成Gemini 3文案与图片生成能力，提供可视化配置界面。
repos.summary_en: RedInk is a one-stop Xiaohongshu image-and-text generator powered by 🍌Nano Banana Pro🍌, enabling instant creation of complete posts from a single sentence. It features AI-driven outline generation, cover page design, and batch content creation. Built with Python Flask backend and Vue 3 frontend, it supports Docker deployment and integrates Gemini 3 for text and image generation with a user-friendly web interface.

repos.description: Self-hosted webscraper.
repos.summary_zh: Scraperr 是一款强大的自托管网页爬虫解决方案，支持无代码配置、XPath精准提取、多任务队列管理、媒体下载及结果可视化导出，适用于数据采集与自动化分析场景。
repos.summary_en: Scraperr is a powerful self-hosted web scraping tool enabling code-free configuration, XPath-based extraction, queue management, media downloads, and structured data export, ideal for automated data collection and analysis.

repos.description: DeepSeek-Compatible Middleware Interface: A technical exploration project in Go, focusing on high-concurrency protocol adaptation. It serves as a reference implementation for converting diverse web protocols into standardized formats.
repos.summary_zh: DS2API 是一个高性能 DeepSeek Web 对话能力转换 API，支持 OpenAI、Claude 和 Gemini 兼容接口。采用 Go 全量实现后端，React 构建管理后台，具备多账号轮询、PoW 验证、Tool Calling 防泄漏处理等核心功能，支持 Docker、Vercel 等多种部署方式，并提供完整的后台管理系统。
repos.summary_en: DS2API is a high-performance API that converts DeepSeek Web chat capabilities into OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini compatible interfaces. Built with full Go backend implementation and React admin UI, it features multi-account polling, PoW verification, Tool Calling protection, and supports deployment via Docker/Vercel. Includes complete management system with account testing and configuration sync.

repos.description: A lightweight, self-hosted personal finance app with a user-friendly interface and powerful bookkeeping features.
repos.summary_zh: ezBookkeeping 是一款轻量级自托管个人财务管理应用，支持 Docker 快速部署，具备用户友好的界面和强大的记账功能。支持多语言、多币种、AI 收据识别、数据导入导出（CSV/OFX/QFX 等），并提供图表分析、地理位置标记、双因素认证等高级特性，适用于 Raspberry Pi、NAS 等低资源设备。
repos.summary_en: ezBookkeeping is a lightweight, self-hosted personal finance app with a user-friendly interface and powerful bookkeeping features. It supports Docker deployment, multi-language/currency, AI receipt recognition, data import/export (CSV/OFX/QFX), chart analytics, location tagging, and 2FA, optimized for low-resource devices like Raspberry Pi and NAS.

repos.description: 这是一个Android系统TTS应用，内置微软演示接口，可自定义HTTP请求，可导入其他本地TTS引擎，以及根据中文双引号的简单旁白/对话识别朗读 ，还有自动重试，备用配置，文本替换等更多功能。
repos.summary_zh: TTS Server 是一款专为 Android 设计的文本转语音应用，集成微软演示接口，支持自定义 HTTP 请求、本地 TTS 引擎导入及基于中文双引号的智能旁白识别朗读，具备自动重试、备用配置和文本替换等高级功能，适用于多场景语音合成需求。
repos.summary_en: TTS Server is an Android-based text-to-speech application featuring Microsoft demo interface integration, customizable HTTP requests, local TTS engine support, and smart narration recognition via Chinese quotation marks. It includes advanced features like auto-retry, fallback configurations, and text replacement for versatile speech synthesis.

repos.description: 一站式域名服务平台，集成短链生成、无限域名邮箱、文件存储和子域名管理，带有管理员面板，支持自部署
repos.summary_zh: WR.DO 是一个功能强大的自托管域名服务平台，集成短链生成、无限域名邮箱、子域名管理、多平台文件存储和开放API接口。支持自定义短链、密码保护、访问统计、邮件推送等功能，提供完整的管理员面板，适合个人或企业自建域名服务基础设施。
repos.summary_en: WR.DO is a comprehensive self-hosted domain platform integrating short link generation, unlimited domain email, subdomain management, multi-cloud file storage, and open APIs. It supports custom links, password protection, analytics, email notifications, and provides a full admin panel for building private domain infrastructure.

repos.description: ✨ The open-source multi-agent platform. Every agent gets its own computer, desktop, network, and long-term memory.  You can bring your own key, or host your coding agent like Claude Code, Codex and so on.
repos.summary_zh: Memoh 是一个自托管的容器化 AI 智能体平台，支持创建多个具备长期记忆能力的独立机器人。通过 Docker 实现容器级隔离，可连接 Telegram、Discord、Feishu（Lark）、Matrix 等通信渠道，提供图形化配置界面和 MCP 工具调用能力，适用于家庭或团队的多成员协作场景。
repos.summary_en: Memoh is a self-hosted, containerized AI agent platform enabling multiple bots with persistent long-term memory. Each bot runs in isolated containers and integrates with platforms like Telegram, Discord, Feishu (Lark), and Matrix via a web UI, supporting role-based access and cross-platform identity recognition for team or family use.

repos.description: 开箱即有 800+ 可稳定流畅播放频道的自托管 IPTV 直播源管理与分发系统，聚合了央视频、咪咕、央视、卫视、凤凰卫视、亚太、国际、地方台、体育赛事、抖音直播、B 站直播、斗鱼直播、虎牙直播、会场、场馆等，以及自定义抓取源和订阅，并提供 EPG 节目单与聚合功能；另外还自带 GUI 可视化管理后台，支持 Docker Compose 或 Node.js 运行，适合 NAS 与家庭服务器。
repos.summary_zh: 生成失败
repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: Emby Android TV 客户端
repos.summary_zh: ChaiChaiEmbyTV 是一款专为 Android TV 设计的 Emby 客户端，支持原生遥控器操作、弹幕播放、多服务器管理及播放进度同步。采用 Jetpack Compose + Media3 + AkDanmaku 技术栈，提供流畅的电视端观影体验，兼容主流弹幕 API，适合家庭影院场景。
repos.summary_en: ChaiChaiEmbyTV is a native Android TV client for Emby media server, featuring remote-control optimized UI, danmaku support via multiple APIs, multi-server management, and playback progress sync. Built with Jetpack Compose, Media3, and AkDanmaku for smooth TV streaming experience.

repos.description: A project converting the Qwen web page to an API.
repos.summary_zh: qwen2API 将通义千问网页版对话能力转换为 OpenAI、Claude 与 Gemini 兼容 API，采用 Python FastAPI + Camoufox 无头浏览器架构。支持全协议原生适配、Tool Calling 工具调用、JSON 异常自愈、账号轮询容灾、Aliyun WAF 绕过及精准 Token 计费，提供企业级模块化网关服务。
repos.summary_en: qwen2API converts Qwen's web interface into an OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini-compatible API using Python FastAPI and Camoufox headless browser. It supports native protocol adaptation, tool calling, JSON error self-healing, account failover, Aliyun WAF bypassing, and precise token billing for enterprise-grade modular gateway services.

repos.summary_zh: 生成失败
repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: 开箱即用的微信公众平台API模拟服务器，帮助你开发与调试微信公众平台应用
repos.summary_zh: Wecheat 是一个开箱即用的微信公众平台API模拟器，基于 Sinatra 框架开发，提供完整的仿真数据与消息交互功能，支持文本、图片、视频等多种消息类型及事件通知，适用于微信应用开发与调试。
repos.summary_en: Wecheat is an out-of-the-box WeChat Official Account API simulator built on the Sinatra framework, offering comprehensive fake data and message interactions including text, images, videos, and events, ideal for developing and debugging WeChat applications.

repos.description: Versatile downloader for audio, video, podcasts, PDFs and more. Available as CLI and Docker | 多功能下载工具，支持音视频、播客、PDF等，提供 CLI 和 Docker 两种方式
repos.summary_zh: vget 是一款多功能下载工具，支持从音视频、播客、社交媒体（如小红书、Twitter）及WebDAV等资源下载内容，提供 CLI 和 Docker 部署方式，具备多语言支持和交互式配置向导，适用于跨平台自动化下载场景。
repos.summary_en: vget is a versatile downloader supporting audio, video, podcasts, PDFs, and social media content from platforms like Xiaohongshu and Twitter. It offers CLI and Docker deployment, multi-language support, and interactive configuration, ideal for cross-platform automated downloads.

repos.description: 基于deno的抖音视频图文无水印下载，支持cf worker,vercel,deno deploy,docker部署
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Deno 的抖音无水印视频与图文下载服务，支持多平台部署（Deno Deploy、Cloudflare Workers、Vercel、Docker），通过简单 API 调用即可解析并返回原始媒体链接，适用于内容抓取与自动化处理场景。
repos.summary_en: A Deno-based service for downloading watermark-free Douyin videos and images via URL parsing, supporting deployment on Deno Deploy, Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, and Docker. Provides clean media links through a simple GET API for content extraction and automation.

repos.description: Django project template layout
repos.summary_zh: django-layout 是一个基于最佳实践的 Django 项目模板，提供开箱即用的现代化开发体验。集成 uv 依赖管理、ruff/prettier 代码规范、goodconf 环境配置、结构化日志、TailwindCSS 样式方案、pytest 测试框架及 mypy 类型检查，支持 Docker 部署，显著提升 Django 项目初始化效率与生产环境健壮性。
repos.summary_en: django-layout is a modern Django project template offering sane defaults based on best practices. It integrates uv for dependency management, ruff/prettier for linting, goodconf for config, structured logging, TailwindCSS, pytest with coverage, mypy for type safety, and production-ready settings via Docker, streamlining Django project setup and deployment.

repos.description: 月饼TV
repos.summary_zh: MoonCakeTV 是一个基于 Next.js 15 和 TypeScript 的影视聚合搜索服务，支持多源聚合搜索（苹果CMS v10协议）、HLS.js 在线播放、收藏与历史记录、响应式深色主题及可选密码保护，数据持久化存储无需数据库，支持一键 Docker 部署与 HTTPS 自动配置。
repos.summary_en: MoonCakeTV is a simple yet powerful video aggregation and search service built with Next.js 15 and TypeScript. It supports multi-source search via AppleCMS v10 protocol, HLS.js streaming, favorites, watch history, responsive dark mode, optional password protection, and stores data without a database. Features one-click Docker deployment with automatic HTTPS via Caddy.

repos.description: Yet another django based blog created in May 2015
repos.summary_zh: MayBlog 是一个基于 Django 和 Bootstrap 开发的博客系统，于2015年5月创建。支持多用户、多角色、Markdown 写作、SEO 优化，并通过 Docker 实现容器化部署。提供 RESTful API（开发中）和后台管理界面，采用微服务架构设计，适合个人或团队搭建内容管理平台。
repos.summary_en: MayBlog is a Django and Bootstrap-based blog system created in May 2015. It supports multi-user, multi-role access, Markdown writing, SEO optimization, and containerized deployment via Docker. Features include RESTful API (in development), admin interface, and modular deployment configurations, ideal for personal or team content management.

repos.description: 通过可视化向导，根据你的开发技术栈，选择配置好Skills，MCP，Agent的AI开发工具，一键生成容器化Vibe开发环境。
repos.summary_zh: VibeSpace 是一款可视化 AI 开发环境配置工具，通过向导式界面快速生成生产可用的容器化开发环境。支持多语言（Go/Node.js/Python/Rust/Java/C++）、AI 工具（Claude Code/Roo）集成、MCP Server 配置及工作流预设，内置国内镜像源优化，一键输出 Dockerfile、docker-compose.yml 等部署文件，实现安全隔离的 Vibe Coding 开发体验。
repos.summary_en: VibeSpace is a visual configuration tool that generates production-ready containerized AI development environments. It supports multi-language setups (Go, Node.js, Python, Rust, Java, C/C++), integrates AI tools like Claude Code and Roo with MCP servers and workflows, auto-configures domestic mirrors for China users, and outputs deployable Docker artifacts via a guided UI—enabling secure, no-enter Vibe Coding.

repos.description: HF Space Manager 是一个用于管理 Hugging Face Spaces 的 Web 应用程序。它提供了直观的界面和API 接口，让你能够方便地查看和管理多个账号下的所有 Spaces。
repos.summary_zh: HF Space Manager 是一个专为 Hugging Face Spaces 设计的现代化监控管理平台，支持多账号 Spaces 实时状态监控、资源使用统计及远程操作（重启/重建）。采用赛博朋克风格界面，集成 Docker 部署与 RESTful API，提供权限分级控制，适用于个人或团队高效管理 AI 模型部署实例。
repos.summary_en: HF Space Manager is a modern web application for monitoring and managing Hugging Face Spaces instances. It offers real-time status tracking, resource usage metrics (CPU/memory), and remote operations (restart/rebuild) across multiple accounts. Features include a cyberpunk-themed UI, Docker deployment, role-based access control, and a secure REST API for external integrations.

repos.summary_zh: 本项目演示如何使用 Docker Compose 快速搭建基于 Docker 的 Django 应用开发环境，包含 Django、MySQL 和 Redis 服务编排，支持一键构建与部署，适用于容器化 Django 项目的开发与测试。
repos.summary_en: This project demonstrates how to quickly set up a Django development environment using Docker Compose, including orchestration of Django, MySQL, and Redis services. It supports one-click build and deployment, ideal for containerized Django development and testing.

repos.description: VPS上的AI聚合脚本
repos.summary_zh: VPSAI 是一个开源的 AI 服务快速部署工具，专为 VPS 环境设计。它通过一键脚本自动化部署多种流行 AI 服务（如 OneAPI、Open-WebUI 等），支持 Docker/Nginx 环境配置、HTTPS 自动证书申请及数据持久化备份。具备服务监控与更新功能，适用于快速搭建私有化 AI 服务集群。
repos.summary_en: VPSAI is an open-source tool for rapid deployment of AI services on VPS. It automates the setup of popular AI platforms (e.g., OneAPI, Open-WebUI) via one-click scripts, supporting Docker/Nginx configuration, HTTPS with Let's Encrypt, data persistence, and backup. Features service monitoring and updates, ideal for private AI infrastructure deployment.
